product_desc: MSI H81M-P33 micro ATX Motherboard supporting 4th Generation Intel Core/Pentium/Celeron processors on LGA 1150 socket with Intel H81 Express chipset, DDR3 memory, and USB 3.0/SATA 6 Gb/s.

product_features.Storage Configuration: 2 x SATA 6 Gb/s and 2 x SATA 3 Gb/s ports
product_features.Graphics: Onboard graphics (CPU required) with VGA and DVI ports
product_features.Expansion Slots: 1 x PCI-E x16, 1 x PCI-E x1
product_features.Ports: 2 x USB 3.0 (Rear), 4 x USB 2.0 (Front/Rear), 1 x LAN (Gigabit Ethernet), 1 x VGA, 1 x DVI-I, Audio ports, PS/2 mouse/keyboard
product_features.Special Features: Military Class 4 components, OC Genie, Click BIOS 4, Fast Boot, M-Flash
